svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Chat system design
svg.desc: Chat system design. 13 components. Connections: Clients to Load balancer (WebSocket); Load balancer to WebSocket gateway; WebSocket gateway to Chat service; WebSocket gateway to Presence service; Presence service to Presence store; Chat service to Presence store (who is online); Push service to Presence store (offline?); Chat service to Message store (load history); Chat service to messages; messages to Message store (persist); messages to Push service (notify); Push service to APNs; Push service to FCM; Clients to Media storage (upload); Media storage to CDN; Clients to CDN (download).

text.tspan: WebSocket gateways keep clients connected; messages go through Kafka to Cassandra and to push providers for offline users
